objects.taxonomy_description: A small, flat, baked food item typically characterized by a rigid structure and browned surface.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a generally flat, disc-like or irregular geometric form with defined edges.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The surface appears dry, matte, and slightly porous or crumbly rather than glossy or smooth.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The object displays uniform golden-brown to dark-brown hues indicative of baking processes.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item lacks biological features such as fur or skin and is presented as an inanimate edible product.

objects.taxonomy_description: The term 'cooky' refers to a baked food item, distinct from living organisms or inanimate objects like backpacks.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a small, flattened, and typically round or irregular shape consistent with a single serving of baked dough.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The surface appears dry, crumbly, or slightly porous, lacking the smooth skin of fruits or the fibrous texture of raw materials.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The object displays uniform golden-brown to dark-brown hues resulting from the Maillard reaction during baking.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item is rigid yet brittle, often shown alongside other similar items or packaging, distinguishing it from soft goods like fabric backpacks.

objects.taxonomy_description: A toroidal-shaped baked good characterized by a central hole and often a glazed or topped surface.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct toroidal geometry with a visible central hole, distinguishing it from solid round pastries like bagels or buns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior typically features a smooth, shiny glaze, icing, or sprinkles, contrasting with the matte or flour-dusted surface of bread-based items.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Cross_Section_Profile: The body has a uniform, rounded thickness without the layered flakiness seen in croissants or the dense crumb structure of standard bread.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Solid or semi-hollow body with no sound hole required.
Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body).

Functional_Components: Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch.
